title: Finance Manager, Operations and Global Functions
description:
**Finance Manager, Operations and Global Functions**

**Do you enjoy using financial insight to shape decisions and improve business performance?**

  

**Do you enjoy partnering with senior stakeholders across global functions to turn financial insights into sound business decisions?**

**About our Team**

This role is part of the Elsevier Business Decision Support (BDS) team and reports to the Finance Director, Operations and Global Functions. The BDS team serves as a strategic and financial partner to business leadership, enabling better decision-making and driving improved financial performance by translating financial and operational data into forward-looking insights, constructive challenge and actionable recommendations.

  

**About the Role**

As our Finance Manager – Operations & Global Functions, you’ll be a trusted finance partner to senior leaders, helping them manage costs, make sound financial decisions, and shape and deliver their longer-term plans.

  

You’ll support Operations and Global Functions leadership across areas including HR, Strategy, Global Communications and Marketing. You’ll lead budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis for operating expenses and direct costs, turning financial information into clear recommendations and practical actions.

  

As our business moves from traditional workflows towards agentic AI-enabled ways of working, you’ll help leaders understand the financial impact of that change. You’ll model the opportunities, reflect them in forecasts, and monitor outcomes so the business can make informed decisions and adjust course when needed.

  

This hands-on role is suited to an experienced finance professional with strong business acumen, a solid understanding of operational cost drivers and direct-cost management, and the ability to independently partner with and influence senior stakeholders in an international environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

* **Act as a trusted finance partner** to senior leaders across Operations and Global Functions, developing a deep understanding of business priorities, operational processes and underlying cost drivers to support effective decision-making.

* **Take end-to-end ownership of financial planning and performance** for assigned areas, including budgeting, rolling forecasts and long-term planning, ensuring robust assumptions, reliable financial outlooks and clear accountability for risks and opportunities.

* **Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights** , explaining performance drivers, anticipating developments, identifying risks and opportunities, and proactively recommending actions to improve financial outcomes.

* **Provide independent financial challenge and decision support** , evaluating alternatives, developing business cases and scenarios, and influencing strategic and operational decisions through sound financial judgement.

* **Drive direct-cost transparency and productivity improvements** , developing a thorough understanding of cost structures, operational volumes, unit economics and efficiency drivers to identify, quantify and monitor opportunities for sustainable cost improvement.

* **Support business transformation and AI-enabled workflows** , modelling the financial impact of operational and technology changes, incorporating agreed initiatives into financial plans and monitoring the delivery of expected benefits.

* **Ensure high standards of financial integrity and control** , including accurate reporting, robust forecasting, appropriate accruals, effective cost governance and timely resolution of financial issues.

* **Proactively lead the financial agenda across assigned areas** , engaging stakeholders, challenging assumptions, communicating clear financial narratives and driving agreed actions through to completion.

  
  
  

**Requirements**

* A postgraduate qualification in Finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA or MBA (Finance) are valued.

* At least five years of relevant experience in finance business partnering, FP&A, performance consulting or financial advisory, preferably within an international corporate environment, with a proven track record of independently supporting senior stakeholders and owning financial planning for a significant business scope.

* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial performance analysis, management reporting and cost management, including direct costs.

* A proactive, self-driven approach, with demonstrated ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex financial responsibilities, anticipate issues, identify opportunities and deliver results independently.

* Proven ability to understand complex operational processes and cost structures, identify the underlying drivers of financial performance and translate business developments into actionable financial insights and recommendations.

* Experience in scenario planning, investment appraisal, business case development and financial modelling, ideally supporting business transformation or technology-driven initiatives.

* Strong commercial acumen, sound financial judgement and a solid understanding of accounting principles, financial governance and controls, with the confidence to constructively challenge and influence senior stakeholders.

* Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial planning, reporting and analytical tools. Familiarity with SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, Anaplan or Power BI is an advantage.

* Excellent communication, analytical and organisational skills, with fluency in written and spoken English and the ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across functions, geographies and time zones.

  

**Work in a way that works for you**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records.

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

Your role will involve delivering finance and financial management work to a high standard, working closely with your team and stakeholders.

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

Join us as an Analyst \- Financial Controller at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.


To be successful as an Analyst \- Financial Controller, you should have experience with:


* Qualified Accountant – CA/CMA/ACCA.
* Strong academic background – 1st class honour's minimum bachelor degree from a reputable institution.
* Prior experience, if any in a month\-end or quarter\-end focused reporting role or control environment based or finance automation skillset based.
* Strong excel skills.

  

Some other highly valued skills include:


* Good stakeholder engagement skills and understanding \& executing their requirements.
* Understanding of the key accounting principles under IFRS.
* Strong interpersonal skills and excellent communicator.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role will be based out of Chennai.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage the financial operations of the organisation, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of financial reporting.


**Accountabilities**


* Management of the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial statements, and other accounting records in accordance with the relevant accounting standards, rules and regulations.
* Support in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Development and maintenance of a robust system of internal controls to safeguard assets, ensure that there is no fraudulent misreporting, and ensure the accuracy of financial data, including regular assessment of the effectiveness of internal controls addressing any weaknesses or gaps. .
* Development and implementation of up\-to\-date financial policies and procedures to ensure consistent and effective financial practices across the organisation.
* Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of financial systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate financial systems with other enterprise systems.
* Preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
* Coordination with external auditors and regulatory authorities in support of audits and examinations.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
